objective: Assess the evidence needed to evaluate pumping scenarios against land subsidence risk in a groundwater management study
information_needs: Hydraulic head and displacement observations with reconciled datums
Aquifer hydraulic conductivity and storage properties
Calibration of the flow model against observed head
alternatives: Simulate scenarios with a subsidence-capable MODFLOW configuration
Delay scenario analysis until observation datums and calibration are resolved
uncertainties: Simulated subsidence is a conditional projection, not a forecast
